For example, we may aggregate individuals' Usage Data to calculate the percentage of users accessing a specific website feature to analyse general trends in how users are interacting with our website to help improve the website and our service offering.3. We make sure we consider and balance any potential impact on you and your rights (both positive and negative) before we process your personal data for our legitimate interests. We do not use your personal data for activities where our interests are overridden by the impact on you (unless we have your consent or are otherwise required or permitted to by law).Legal obligation: We may use your personal data where it is necessary for compliance with a legal obligation that we are subject to. KLAIM.AI is a Financial Services company. Klaim AI helps healthcare providers, real estate agents, and SMEs get paid within 24 hours without loans, delays, or red tape. KLAIM.AI employs 40 people (-15.3% YoY, -9 people) and has an annual revenue of $2, founded in 2019. Headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, United Arab Emirates. Its workforce is distributed across 8 countries (including United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Philippines, United States, and Russia). Has $65.6M in total funding, with 12 prior funding rounds.
...
In 2019, Klaim emerged as a groundbreaking fintech innovator in the GCC, with an ambitious vision to redefine the financial dynamics for healthcare providers globally. We embarked on a mission to revolutionize the medical claims reimbursement process, focusing on rapid financial solutions.
...
At Klaim, we understand the financial challenges healthcare providers face - the waiting, the uncertainty, the complex processes. That's why we introduced our game-changing USP: "Treat your patient today, receive payment tomorrow." The moment healthcare providers submit their claims to insurance companies, we ensure they receive their payment within 24 hours. This rapid payment turnaround is not just a service; it's our commitment to healthcare providers' financial stability. Healthcare providers receive daily payments for their claims, mirroring the immediacy of cash transactions.
